edge.description: Edge cases: silence, pure tones, white noise — expected to return empty or minimal hallucination

items.notes: Pure silence 0.5 s — below minimum valid threshold; correct output is empty; SenseVoice hallucinates '嗯。'
Pure silence 1.5 s — at lower valid boundary; correct output is empty; SenseVoice hallucinates '我。'
440 Hz sine wave 2 s — non-speech tonal; correct output is empty; SenseVoice hallucinates '我。'
Gaussian white noise σ=0.05, 3 s — non-speech; correct output is empty; FunASR-Nano hallucinates '你是不是在想我？'

out_of_dataset.notes: 5 s tone + 85 s silence — over-long; kept in edge_cases/ subdirectory only, NOT in main dataset/; Apple Speech times out at 30 s; FunASR-Nano ~8 s with hallucination; SenseVoice ~650 ms
